authority: Owner requires fixed faces in all images. Parent approved portrait-first head-only repair workflow for all 50 owned images.
method: Every scene inspected in overview and close face crops beside authoritative neutral portraits. Facial geometry, eye/brow/nose/mouth proportions, jaw/chin, complexion, age and hairline evaluated separately from costume and equipment. Pose and lighting differences are not automatic failures. No biometric identity scoring is claimed.
